candidate.answerReason: Angle B is 55°. Since CD is perpendicular to AB and D lies on AB, triangle BCD is right with the same angle at B, giving angle BCD = 35°.

methods.label: Use two right triangles
methods.explanation: In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle B=90^\circ-35^\circ=55^\circ\). In right triangle \(BCD\), \(\angle BCD=90^\circ-\angle B=35^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: Uses perpendicularity and complementary acute angles in two right triangles, within Grade 8 geometry.
